summary: HUD kit: HD atlas from the 2.4x HUD sheet, native kept for 1x
author: pm
body:
The user upscaled the HUD art sheet from 800x188 to 1920x451, a uniform 2.4x: `working/classic_ui/hd/gamedialog_sprite_6.png`, with the .psd beside it. The HUD should draw from it so it stays sharp on large screens. The user, 2026-11-25: "I also updated this to be wide screen friendly - however we will want to keep the 4:3 version as well". Also: "the games world logic is 4:3 800x600 tile based - so it should cover the same amount whether at 4k or 800x600 ratio".

So the bar does NOT get longer. The HUD covers the same 800 game pixels at every screen size; the HD sheet only adds resolution.

| fact | value |
|---|---|
| new sheet | 1920x451 RGBA, 2.4x (1920/800 exact; 451/2.4 = 187.9, so rows drift less than 1 px) - measured |
| current kit | `staged/client/sprites/hudkit/hud_kit.{png,json}`, 33 frames, built by `tools/panel_kit/build_hud_kit.py` from `working/sprite_work/GameDialog/gamedialog_sprite_6.png` - located |
| old 800x188 sheet | no longer on disk; its pixels survive only in the built `hud_kit.png` - measured |

**Done when:**
- The kit carries an HD atlas built from the new sheet, with the same frame names and layout in game pixels.
- The HUD draws HD frames scaled to the screen whenever the scale is above 1x.
- The native atlas stays and is used at 1x.
- The build works without the missing old sheet.
- Both builds are clean.
- Screenshots at 800x600 and 1920x1080 are attached.

Source: user messages, 2026-11-25; measurement `.claude/scratch/coordinator/hud_wide/measure.py`.

**Closed, 2026-11-25:** commit a92de01c. The user approved the in-game shot (game_hud_1920x1440.png). Two code reviews passed. In-game at 2.4x: the HUD draws from the HD atlas, the bar is split to the edges with 12 px margins, and the Character button opens Character Info. The old kit is archived byte-identical to working/archive/hudkit/. Not checked: an 800x600 in-client shot, and a gauge clip at partial fill.
